يشتملون (form VIII)
# يَشْتَمِلُونَ (yaštamilūna) /jaʃ.ta.mi.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
# يُشْتَمَلُونَ (yuštamalūna) /juʃ.ta.ma.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
